debt_to_equity.description: Debt to Equity Ratio (Total Debt / Equity)

roa.description: Return on Assets ((Net Profit / Total Assets) * 100)

excluded_columns.Year: Temporal marker, not a financial performance anomaly indicator
excluded_columns.Market Cap(in B USD): Market valuation metric outside financial statements; contains missing value
excluded_columns.Revenue: Absolute dollar scale bias; large entities would be flagged solely for size
excluded_columns.EBITDA: Not standardized or extracted in Stage 1 schema
excluded_columns.Earning Per Share: Per-share metric dependent on unmodeled outstanding shares count
excluded_columns.Free Cash Flow per Share: Per-share cash metric outside Stage 1 extraction
excluded_columns.Cash Flow from Operating: Cash flow statement line not in Stage 1 extraction
excluded_columns.Cash Flow from Investing: Cash flow statement line not in Stage 1 extraction
excluded_columns.Cash Flow from Financial Activities: Cash flow statement line not in Stage 1 extraction
excluded_columns.ROI: Return on Investment is not defined in Agent 1 8 canonical ratios
excluded_columns.Return on Tangible Equity: Not defined in Agent 1 8 canonical ratios
excluded_columns.Inflation Rate(in US): External macroeconomic indicator, not company statement data
